settings.heading: Software your team will use.
settings.subcopy: Dashboards, portals, internal tools and SaaS products, designed properly and engineered to be maintained, not just demoed.
settings.image_alt: socal BioMed Waverly CL4M mini centrifuge product page

settings.heading: Why most internal tools fail
settings.subcopy: None of these are solved by another spreadsheet.

settings.pain: We shipped a demo. Nobody uses it in production.
settings.answer: Discovery starts with the job to be done and the metric, not a feature list. Staging you can open every week.

settings.pain: Every change needs the original freelancer.
settings.answer: Tests, docs and a handover. You own the repo. We can leave cleanly.

settings.pain: Integrations are duct tape, they break every month.
settings.answer: APIs designed, versioned and monitored by the same team that ships the UI.

settings.pain: The numbers in the meeting don't match the database.
settings.answer: Reporting and pipelines built with the product, not bolted on after launch.

settings.heading: From a single tool to a whole platform
settings.subcopy: Stack we ship most often: React, Next.js, Node, PostgreSQL, and well-documented APIs.

settings.title: Internal tools & admin
settings.copy: Operations dashboards, back offices and approval flows that replace a spreadsheet nobody trusts.

settings.title: Customer portals
settings.copy: Account areas, billing views and self-service that takes work off your support team.

settings.title: SaaS products
settings.copy: Multi-tenant products with auth, billing, roles and the boring infrastructure that makes them sellable.

settings.title: APIs & integrations
settings.copy: The layer between your systems, designed, documented and versioned rather than bolted on.

settings.title: Data & reporting
settings.copy: Pipelines and dashboards so the numbers in the meeting reconcile with the numbers in the database.

settings.title: Rescue & rebuild
settings.copy: Inheriting something half-finished. We audit first and tell you honestly whether to fix or restart.

settings.heading: Build · Launch · Retain
settings.subcopy: Scope agreed in discovery. Exact deliverables written before code starts.

settings.title: Build Pack
settings.copy: Discovery, fixed scope, design system and a first production release on staging you can open.

settings.title: Launch Pack
settings.copy: Hardening, analytics, docs and go-live, plus a two-week hypercare window.

settings.title: Retain
settings.copy: Monthly product increments, monitoring and a backlog you can see, not a black box retainer.

settings.heading: From brief to production
settings.subcopy: Fixed scope, fixed sequence, staging you can open whenever you like.

settings.title: Discovery
settings.copy: Users, goals, constraints and the metric this has to move.

settings.title: Definition
settings.copy: Flows, scope and a fixed number, before design starts.

settings.title: Design
settings.copy: A system and a clickable prototype, reviewed before build.

settings.title: Build
settings.copy: Two-week increments on staging, with tests as we go.

settings.title: Hardening
settings.copy: Performance, accessibility, security review and QA.

settings.title: Launch & support
settings.copy: Deploy, monitor, document, hand over or stay on retainer.

settings.heading: Got a system that needs building?
settings.subcopy: Send us the problem, even if the spec doesn't exist yet.
